results.title: ISO 2768-1:1989 General tolerances
results.content: General tolerances for linear and angular dimensions without individual tolerance indications. Tolerance class m applies a permissible deviation of 0.2 mm for nominal lengths over 30 up to 120 mm.

results.title: On the interpretation of general tolerance classes
results.content: We compare the deviation envelopes implied by ISO 2768 classes f, m, c and v across 412 machined features and report a systematic bias of 0.03 mm in class m.
